flags.issue: Given only as a rule ('fifth business day following' each Coupon Observation Date); derived with NYSE calendar. Filing's 'business day' may be a banking-day definition (product supplement) rather than NYSE trading day; e.g. 2027-03-25 +5 skips Good Friday 2027-03-26 (NYSE closed, banks open) giving 2027-04-02 vs 2027-04-01 under a banking calendar. Verify each date.
Filing states only that the estimated value is 'not less than the principal amount' ($10); set to null. Human may decide whether to treat as 10.
Final Coupon Observation Date (2029-09-25) is not a Call Observation Date (call dates end June 25, 2029), so 10 levels for obs #2-#11.
Names stored with the ® mark as rendered in the cleaned file ('S&P 500 ® Index', etc., with a space before ®).
Tickers taken from Bloomberg symbols (SPX Index, INDU Index, NDX Index) with ' Index' suffix dropped.

scope.reason: Worst-of contingent-coupon autocallable on three equity indices (SPX, INDU, NDX); quarterly discrete autocall at 100% from obs #2; non-memory 2.475% quarterly coupon with 70% barrier; European (final-date-only) 60% barrier with 1-to-1 loss from Starting Value (not buffered).
